name: va_pumped_bass
description: Pumped bass: one saw an octave down, mono with a long glide between notes, thinned by a high-pass at 180 Hz, pumping on every beat like a side-chain keyed by a kick (Global LFO 1 duck on the volume: down about 12 dB, held 70 ms, back up over 350 ms on an exponential curve); its demo is a two-bar riff at 130 bpm.
